download_paralleldomain4d_dataset: run the python script to download the Parallel Domain 4D dataset to a target directory
extract_paralleldomain4d_archives: run the python script to extract Parallel Domain 4D tar archives to an extraction directory
merge_paralleldomain4d_scenes: run the python script to merge extracted data and human_pose folders into a unified paralleldomain4d structure
download_and_process_paralleldomain4d_al: run the python script to download, extract, and merge the Parallel Domain 4D dataset in one command
merge_single_scene_helper: run the python script to merge a single scene directory from data and human_pose sources into the target path
